rationale: C08 is the strongest plausible drafting template. It uses nearly the same two-recital structure and restoration machinery as the child: Hawaiian ceded public lands on Oahu reserved for military purposes, a finding that the described land is no longer needed, and restoration to the Territory's possession, use, and control. Its distinctive wording—especially “certain lands,” “forming/form a part of the public lands ceded and transferred,” and “no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest”—closely tracks the child and goes beyond generic subject similarity. C16 and C22 share much of the same formula, but C08 is closer in geography, plurality, disposition language, and presidential-era drafting style.

shared_material.child_excerpt: certain hereinafter-described land in Waianae, District of Waianae, Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, forming a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750
shared_material.parent_excerpt: certain lands In Waianae-Uka, District of Walanae; and Waikakalaua, District of Ewa, Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, which form a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United State3 under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750
shared_material.explanation: The recitals share a highly parallel description of Waianae/Oahu land, its status as Hawaiian ceded public land, and the same annexation authority.

shared_material.child_excerpt: was reserved for military purposes by Executive Order No. 801 of June 6, 1938, of the Governor of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: were reserved for military purposes by Executive Order of July 20, 1899, as modified by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE]
shared_material.explanation: Both identify the prior military reservation instrument in the same position and grammatical role.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such land is no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that it be restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the hereinafter-described parcels of such lands are no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly verbatim, distinctive operative-premise language supporting direct reuse of a drafting template.
